# volcano_database (Resource)

A provisioned PostgreSQL database within a Volcano project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_database" "main" {
  project_id    = volcano_project.example.id
  name          = "main"
  region        = "us-east-1"
  pg_version    = "16"
  database_type = "volcano-db-xs"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only. Unique within the project. Forces replacement if changed.
- `pg_version` (String) PostgreSQL major version ("15" or "16"). Forces replacement if changed.
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String) Hosting region, e.g. us-east-1. See the volcano_database_regions data source for valid values. Forces replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `database_type` (String) Compute size tier. Defaults to volcano-db-xs. Mutable in place via the dedicated resize endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `connection_string` (String, Sensitive) PostgreSQL connection URI with full admin access.
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) provisioning, active, failed, restoring, or deleting.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_database.main <project-id>,<database-name>
```
